A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their text, figures, equations, and complete appendices are readable, and relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original Gemma activation-patching experiments and trained-transformer experiments on numerical and geometric tasks, including additional results in Appendices A and B.

after.justification: V2 retains original activation-patching, probing, steering, and representation-geometry results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Activation patching with type-corrected answers, grouped-head interventions, task-vector extraction, and interpolation-based steering remain unchanged. V2 rewrites their explanation without introducing a different procedure or architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions study geography and company puzzles, add-k, circular trajectories, and rectangular trajectories. Rectangular trajectories receive greater introductory emphasis in v2 but were already evaluated in v1 Appendix B.3.

E2.justification: The Gemma-2-27B/2B comparisons and corresponding patched-versus-unpatched comparisons are retained. Newly cited related work is not added as evaluated comparison methods.

E3.justification: The reported geography dataset size changes from 'over 40 countries' in v1 Section 2.1 to 40 in v2 Section 2. This is a limited revision to the stated sample size, without establishing resampling or rerunning. Shot counts, intervention settings, metrics, and synthetic-model training settings otherwise match.

E4.justification: The shot-count analysis moves from v1 Section 2.3/Figure 5 to v2 Appendix A.3/Figure 27. Intervention-scaling analyses, output-concept controls, MLP analyses, the 32-offset helix experiment, and clockwise/counterclockwise analyses are also retained.

E5.justification: Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Existing empirical distributions and percentile summaries retain the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: Matched empirical scores and plots are unchanged. Examples include the above-73% top-10 intervention result in Figure 3, company accuracies of 73.5%, 80.7%, and 88.6%, and the PCA variance percentages. Figure 2 is redrawn with the same accuracy values.

T1.justification: The new F = R ◦ C notation explains the existing concept-composition account. Mathematical task definitions and the appendix's type-corrected CMA equations are retained; equation relocation and renumbering introduce no substantive derivation, proof, or formal guarantee.

C1.justification: The central composition and low-dimensional task-vector claims remain. V2's introductory contributions additionally assert orthogonality of latent concepts and more directly attribute accuracy improvements to increased circuit utilization, modestly strengthening the claim formulation.

C2.justification: V2 explicitly predicts intervention behavior under the shortcut explanation and interprets rectangular-task geometry as separating orthogonal parameters and smoothly interpolating between shapes. Appendix C retains the same English-only and human-interpretable-concept limitations.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 newly specifies ChatGPT o3, JSON dictionaries, and distinct bridge entities within prompts. Reported LLM compute changes from about 160 to 200 hours on two H200 GPUs, and Appendix D adds an LLM-use disclosure. V1's minimum of ten entities per country/source type is omitted. These disclosures do not establish procedural changes.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations to Li et al. (2023), Minegishi et al. (2025), Venhoff et al. (2025), and Soligo et al. (2025). These modestly expand the existing positioning around ICL mechanisms and representation vectors without redefining the research contribution.

P1.justification: The abstract and introduction are extensively rewritten, preliminaries are introduced, and related work moves from Section 4 to Section 1.2. Section 2 is reorganized around explicit hypotheses and worked interventions, while detailed output-head and shot-count discussions shift to the appendices.

P2.justification: The document is reformatted throughout, with substantial redistribution of figures and separation of appendix prose from figure blocks. Figure 2 receives new colors, legends, and axis formatting; v1 Figure 5 moves to v2 Figure 27; the redundant v1 Figure 4 display disappears while fuller corresponding heatmaps remain.

improvement.justification: V2 explains the causal test more clearly through explicit competing explanations and a worked type-corrected intervention, while expanded data-generation documentation improves reproducibility. These are limited gains because the empirical evidence is unchanged. Some entity-count detail is lost, and stronger orthogonality wording receives no additional validation.
